owner.rule: ALG03 owns Algorithms-specific evidence semantics and grader contracts. C4 owns generic mastery aggregation/state; execution providers emit evidence only.

reasoningDimensions.title: Representation
reasoningDimensions.description: Model the data/ADT/graph/tree representation and state semantics correctly.

reasoningDimensions.title: Strategy selection
reasoningDimensions.description: Choose an algorithmic strategy that satisfies constraints and preconditions.

reasoningDimensions.title: State trace
reasoningDimensions.description: Track meaningful canonical algorithm state rather than bytecode/runtime noise.

reasoningDimensions.title: Invariant reasoning
reasoningDimensions.description: State and use the invariant or structural property that stays true.

reasoningDimensions.title: Correctness
reasoningDimensions.description: Connect preconditions, invariant, termination and postcondition or provide a counterexample.

reasoningDimensions.title: Complexity
reasoningDimensions.description: Identify size measure, case, representation, time/space and justified asymptotic bound.

reasoningDimensions.title: Implementation
reasoningDimensions.description: Implement behavior without relying on one reference source shape.

reasoningDimensions.title: Testing
reasoningDimensions.description: Use edge cases/properties that could falsify the solution.

reasoningDimensions.title: Trade-off
reasoningDimensions.description: Explain why the chosen structure/algorithm fits the workload and what is sacrificed.

reasoningDimensions.title: Explanation
reasoningDimensions.description: Communicate assumptions, steps, limitations and transfer clearly.

evidenceLevels.meaning: Can observe/recognize a result; insufficient alone for competence.
Can execute/trace a declared algorithm or operation correctly.
Can explain representation, strategy, precondition and state changes.
Can justify correctness and complexity with invariant/assumption evidence.
Can choose/adapt the approach on a structurally similar but surface-changed task.

resultDimensions.overallRule: A task may require all declared hard constraints. Functional correctness cannot silently override a failed complexity/memory/precondition requirement.

anchors.3: correct for declared scope with minor omission
anchors.4: correct, justified, edge-aware and transferable for the requested dimension

retryPolicy.subjectRecommendation: After a material algorithmic error, route to targeted remediation and/or a changed-surface retry rather than unlimited identical resubmission.

can: generate temporary practice under canonical contracts
